scenarios.label: Pause then continue
scenarios.description: Two turns, each with a 0.45–1.0 s thinking pause before the speaker finishes. Tests premature endpointing.

scenarios.label: Short answer
scenarios.description: Three one- or two-word turns. Tests responsiveness to brief, complete answers.

scenarios.label: Multi-turn
scenarios.description: Three turns with zero to two short within-turn pauses each.

scenarios.label: Barge-in
scenarios.description: A question, then the user interrupts the agent's long answer with a new request.

scenarios.label: Backchannel
scenarios.description: Short listener responses ("mm hm", "yeah") while the agent speaks; these should not cancel the answer.

scenarios.label: Free conversation
scenarios.description: Talk to the agent through your microphone. Unlabelled: latency and events only.

notes: Simulated providers: STT/LLM/TTS latencies are modelled, not measured; audio is synthetic and says nothing about real speakers.

turn_f1.label: Turn F1
turn_f1.definition: Harmonic mean of turn-completion precision and recall (tolerance window [end−early, end+late]).

turn_precision.label: Turn precision
turn_precision.definition: Committed turn ends that match an annotated end within the tolerance window.

turn_recall.label: Turn recall
turn_recall.definition: Annotated turn ends matched by a committed turn end within the tolerance window.

premature_end_rate.label: Premature-end rate
premature_end_rate.definition: Annotated turns during which the system committed completion earlier than end − early tolerance.

missed_end_rate.label: Missed-end rate
missed_end_rate.definition: Annotated turn ends with no committed completion inside the evaluation window.

turn_end_delay_p50_ms.label: Turn-end delay p50
turn_end_delay_p50_ms.definition: Committed TURN_COMPLETE minus annotated turn end, matched pairs. Lower is better only if premature ends do not rise.

response_start_p50_ms.label: Response start p50
response_start_p50_ms.definition: Last user frame used for the completion decision → first response audio delivered.

detector_inference_p50_ms.label: Detector inference p50
detector_inference_p50_ms.definition: Wall time of one detector call per 20 ms frame.

false_barge_in_rate.label: False barge-in rate
false_barge_in_rate.definition: Agent output intervals cancelled without a genuine user interruption (e.g. by a backchannel).

missed_barge_in_rate.label: Missed barge-in rate
missed_barge_in_rate.definition: Genuine interruptions not acted on within the barge-in window.

stale_chunks_played.label: Stale chunks played
stale_chunks_played.definition: Audio chunks of a cancelled response played after cancellation (target 0).

warnings: Some groups have fewer than 3 trials; confidence intervals are wide or absent.
Simulated trials use synthetic voices and modelled provider latency; they test the pipeline, not real-speaker generalisation.
